tutorial.welcome.en: Welcome, young leader. I am Sensei Hoshi. Our clan has found a hidden valley in the mountains. Let's build a village no rival can find.
tutorial.welcome.text: Siyakwamukela, mholi omusha. Nginguye uSensei Hoshi. Isizwe sethu sithole isigodi esifihlekile ezintabeni. Masakhe isigodi okungekho mbangi engasithola.

tutorial.mint.collect.en: Your Coin Mint is striking Coins. When a coin floats over it, tap it, then Collect.
tutorial.mint.collect.text: Isigayo Sezinhlamvu sakho senza izinhlamvu. Uma uhlamvu luntanta phezu kwaso, luthinte, bese uthinta u-Qoqa.

tutorial.mint.build.en: A clan runs on Coins. Tap Build and place a Coin Mint.
tutorial.mint.build.text: Isizwe siphila ngezinhlamvu. Thinta u-Yakha bese ubeka Isigayo Sezinhlamvu.

tutorial.keep.en: Now strengthen the Clan Keep: tap the castle, then Upgrade.
tutorial.keep.text: Manje qinisa Inqaba Yesizwe: thinta inqaba, bese uthinta u-Thuthukisa.

tutorial.finishKeep.wait.en: Upgrades take time. The Keep is ready in {time}: come back then, or tap Finish now to use a little Jade.
tutorial.finishKeep.wait.text: Ukuthuthukisa kuthatha isikhathi. Inqaba izolunga kungakapheli isikhathi esingu-{time}: buya ngaleso sikhathi, noma uthinte u-Qeda manje ukuze usebenzise ijeyidi elincane.

tutorial.finishKeep.done.en: The Keep is ready. Well done!

tutorial.army.tower.en: Rival clans will raid us. Build a Kunai Tower next to the Keep (Build, then the Defense tab): it shoots any raider in range.
tutorial.army.tower.text: Izizwe eziyizimbangi zizosigasela. Yakha Umbhoshongo We-Kunai eduze kwenqaba (Yakha, bese uthinta ithebhu ethi Ukuvikela): udubula noma yimuphi umgaseli osondele.

tutorial.army.all.en: Build a Training Dojo, a Squad Courtyard and a Kunai Tower next to the Keep (Build: the Army tab, then the Defense tab).
tutorial.army.all.text: Yakha Idojo Lokuqeqesha, Igceke Lamaqembu noMbhoshongo We-Kunai eduze kwenqaba (Yakha: ithebhu ethi Ibutho, bese ithebhu ethi Ukuvikela).

tutorial.train.en: Open the Army panel and train some Shinobi: fast blades that strike the nearest building.
tutorial.train.text: Vula iphaneli ye-Ibutho bese uqeqesha ama-Shinobi: izinkemba ezisheshayo ezihlasela isakhiwo esiseduze kakhulu.

tutorial.finishTrain.wait.en: Training takes time too: your warriors are ready in {time}. Wait, or tap Finish training to use a little Jade.
tutorial.finishTrain.wait.text: Ukuqeqesha nakho kuthatha isikhathi: amaqhawe akho azolunga kungakapheli isikhathi esingu-{time}. Linda, noma uthinte u-Qeda ukuqeqesha ukuze usebenzise ijeyidi elincane.

tutorial.raid.en: Your first raid. Tap Attack, look over the target, then Attack! On the battlefield I will show you one thing at a time: send your Shinobi in through a glowing point, then smoke them as they reach a tower: warriors inside the smoke can only be shot from close up.
tutorial.raid.text: Ukugasela kwakho kokuqala. Thinta u-Hlasela, ubheke okuhlosiwe, bese uthi Hlasela! Enkundleni yempi ngizokukhombisa into eyodwa ngesikhathi: ngenisa ama-Shinobi akho ngephuzu elikhanyayo, bese uwafaka entuthwini lapho efika embhoshongweni: amaqhawe angaphakathi entuthwini angadutshulwa kuphela uma umuntu eseduze.

tutorial.end.en: Well fought. Upgrade the Training Dojo to unlock Saboteurs: they jam a defense for a few seconds. Jam first, then strike, and smoke your warriors where the fire is heaviest. Collect, upgrade, raid, and join an Alliance.
tutorial.end.text: Ulwe kahle. Thuthukisa Idojo Lokuqeqesha ukuze uvule Abonakalisi: bamisa isivikelo imizuzwana embalwa. Qala ngokumisa, bese uyahlasela, futhi ufake amaqhawe akho entuthwini lapho umlilo unamandla khona. Qoqa, thuthukisa, gasela, futhi ujoyine Umfelandawonye.

objective.builders.text: Ingcweti elandelayo izokhululeka kungakapheli isikhathi esingu-{time}

calendar.about.en: One reward a day, the same for everyone, never random and never sold. Miss a day and nothing is lost: the next claim is the next day on the list. Day 28 gives a Keep look.
calendar.about.text: Umklomelo owodwa ngosuku, ofanayo kubo bonke, ongakhethwa ngenhlanhla futhi ongathengiswa. Uma weqa usuku akukho okulahlekayo: umklomelo olandelayo uwusuku olulandelayo ohlwini. Usuku lwama-28 lunika ukubukeka kwenqaba.

calendar.next.text: Usuku lwekhalenda olulandelayo kungakapheli isikhathi esingu-{time}.

calendar.gotLook.en: A new Keep look is yours: Store → Looks.
calendar.gotLook.text: Ukubukeka okusha kwenqaba sekungokwakho: Isitolo → Ukubukeka.

offers.noAge.en: Special offers appear only once you have told us your age (Settings → Account → Spending → Set age group).
offers.noAge.text: Iminikelo ekhethekile ivela kuphela uma usutshele iminyaka yakho (Izilungiselelo → I-akhawunti → Ukusebenzisa imali → Setha iqembu leminyaka).

offers.minor.en: Special offers do not pop up for players under 18. Everything in the Jade tab stays available within your spending limit.
offers.minor.text: Iminikelo ekhethekile ayiveli ngokuzumayo kubadlali abangaphansi kweminyaka eyi-18. Konke okusethebhini yeJeyidi kuhlala kutholakala ngaphakathi komkhawulo wakho wokusebenzisa imali.

settings.languageNote.text: Igeyimu ilandela ulimi lwedivayisi yakho uma ikwazi. Ezinye izilimi zizofika lapho ukuhumusha kwazo sekuqediwe.

store.withdrawalStipend.en: Delivery starts at once: the first payment can be claimed now and one more each day; by buying you agree that you lose the right to cancel, as the law allows for digital content.
store.withdrawalStipend.text: Ukulethwa kuqala ngokushesha: inkokhelo yokuqala ingathathwa manje bese enye usuku ngalunye; ngokuthenga uyavuma ukuthi ulahlekelwa ilungelo lokukhansela, njengoba umthetho uvumela kokuqukethwe kwedijithali.

store.error.unavailable.en: Purchases are not available right now. Try again later.
store.error.unavailable.text: Ukuthenga akutholakali njengamanje. Zama futhi emuva kwesikhathi.

store.error.failed.en: The purchase did not go through. If you were charged, it is delivered as soon as the store confirms it.
store.error.failed.text: Ukuthenga akuphumelelanga. Uma ukhokhisiwe, kuzolethwa ngokushesha lapho isitolo sikuqinisekisa.

raid.rejected.no_warriors.en: No warriors fought, so it counts as practice.
raid.rejected.no_warriors.text: Alikho iqhawe elilwile, ngakho kubalwa njengokuzijwayeza.

temper.intro.en: Shape every {building} at once. Reach shoots farther but hits softer and goes for back-line warriors first; Blast hits groups but fires slower; Watch makes the Sky Bow Tower, the Bitter Smoke Brazier and traps stronger. Raiders see the shape when they scout.
temper.intro.text: Lolonga yonke into ethi {building} ngesikhathi esisodwa. Ibanga lidubula kude kodwa lishaya kancane futhi liqala ngamaqhawe angemuva; Ukuqhuma kushaya amaqembu kodwa kudubula kancane; Ukulinda kuqinisa Umbhoshongo Womnsalo Wesibhakabhaka, Isitofu Sentuthu Ebabayo nezicupho. Abagaseli bayabona ukulolongwa lapho behlola.

temper.left.en: {n, plural, one {# point left} other {# points left}}
temper.left.text: {n, plural, one {kusele iphuzu elingu-#} other {kusele amaphuzu angu-#}}

temper.done.en: Tempered: every {building} has its new shape.

temper.watchSupport.en: Watch also weakens the raiders' healing, revives, toughness and shield cover across the whole base.
temper.watchSupport.text: Ukulinda kuphinde kwenze buthaka ukwelapha kwabagaseli, ukuvuselela, ukuqina nokuvikelwa yizihlangu kuyo yonke inqaba.

stake.help.en: Declare a result before you attack: reach it and carry more loot home, miss it and carry none.
stake.help.text: Memezela umphumela ngaphambi kokuhlasela: uwufinyelele bese uthwala impango eningi ekhaya, uwuphuthe bese ungathwali lutho.

stake.missed.en: Stake missed: you declared {stars}★, so no loot came home.
stake.missed.text: Isibambiso siphuthiwe: umemezele {stars}★, ngakho ayikho impango efike ekhaya.

carry.diversity.en: Your squad carried {pct} of the loot. Squads of more roles carry more.
carry.diversity.text: Iqembu lakho lithwale impango engu-{pct}. Amaqembu anezindima eziningi athwala okuningi.

raid.rejected.conflict.en: The opponent changed at the same moment.

raid.rejected.version_mismatch.en: This version of the game is too old.

res.debt.en: You owe {amount} {resource} from a refunded purchase. It is paid back from your future income; nothing else is taken.
res.debt.text: Unesikweletu ngenxa yokuthenga okubuyiselwe imali: {amount} {resource}. Sikhokhwa ngemali yakho engenayo yesikhathi esizayo; akukho okunye okuthathwayo.

sync.refused.en: {n, plural, one {The server refused # action because your village had changed, for example on another device. The village on the server is the one kept.} other {The server refused # actions because your village had changed, for example on another device. The village on the server is the one kept.}}
sync.refused.text: {n, plural, one {Iseva yenqabe isenzo esingu-# ngoba isigodi sakho besesishintshile, isibonelo kwenye idivayisi. Kugcinwa isigodi esikuseva.} other {Iseva yenqabe izenzo ezingu-# ngoba isigodi sakho besesishintshile, isibonelo kwenye idivayisi. Kugcinwa isigodi esikuseva.}}

news.offline.en: Messages from the game's operators arrive when you play online.
news.offline.text: Imilayezo evela kubaphathi begeyimu ifika uma udlala ku-inthanethi.

account.signOutDevice.note.en: Finished playing on this phone or browser? Sign it out. Your online account stays for your other devices and linked sign-ins.
account.signOutDevice.note.text: Usuqedile ukudlala kule foni noma kulesi siphequluli? Yikhiphe. I-akhawunti yakho ye-inthanethi isala kwamanye amadivayisi akho nakwizindlela zokungena ezixhunyiwe.

account.signOutDevice.body.en: Online play turns off here and this device forgets its key to your online account. The village on this device stays. To play the account here again, sign in with a linked Apple, Google or Game Center account.
account.signOutDevice.body.text: Ukudlala ku-inthanethi kuyavalwa lapha futhi le divayisi ikhohlwa ukhiye wayo we-akhawunti yakho ye-inthanethi. Isigodi esikule divayisi siyasala. Ukuze uphinde udlale le akhawunti lapha, ngena nge-akhawunti ye-Apple, ye-Google noma ye-Game Center exhunyiwe.

account.signOutDevice.done.en: This device is signed out. Online play is off here.
account.signOutDevice.done.text: Le divayisi ikhishiwe. Ukudlala ku-inthanethi kuvaliwe lapha.

account.signOutDevice.lastKey.en: Not signed out: this device holds the only key to your online account. Link Apple, Google or Game Center first, or delete the account instead.
account.signOutDevice.lastKey.text: Akukhishwanga: le divayisi iphethe ukhiye okuwukuphela kwawo we-akhawunti yakho ye-inthanethi. Qala uxhume i-Apple, i-Google noma i-Game Center, noma esikhundleni salokho susa i-akhawunti.

news.reason.resources.en: There were not enough resources in your village on the server.
news.reason.resources.text: Bekungekho izinsiza ezanele esigodini sakho kuseva.

news.reason.maxLevel.en: It was already at its highest level.

news.reason.gone.en: It was no longer in your village.

news.reason.busy.en: It was already being worked on.

news.reason.limit.en: The limit for it was already reached.

news.reason.changed.en: Your village had already changed, for example on another device.
news.reason.changed.text: Isigodi sakho besesishintshile, isibonelo kwenye idivayisi.

refusal.storageFullRefund.en: Storage is too full: cancelling now would lose {lost} of the {refund} you would get back. Make room first.
refusal.storageFullRefund.text: Iziphala zigcwele kakhulu: ukukhansela manje kungalahlekisa ingxenye yalokho obungakubuyiselwa. Kungalahleka: {lost}. Obekuzobuyiswa: {refund}. Qala wenze indawo.

league.boardOnline.en: The leaderboards are part of online play.

sheet.raidRule.en: Raiders can take {pct} of what your storages hold, never more than {cap} of each resource while your Keep is level {level}, and {collectors} of what your collectors have not collected yet.
sheet.raidRule.text: Abagaseli bangathatha {pct} kwalokho okugcinwe eziphaleni zakho (umkhawulo wensiza ngayinye: {cap} ngenkathi Inqaba yakho isezingeni {level}), futhi kulokho iziqoqi zakho ezingakakuqoqi bangathatha {collectors}.

sheet.collectorPause.en: It produces nothing while it upgrades ({time}). What it holds now stays and can still be collected.
sheet.collectorPause.text: Ayikhiqizi lutho ngenkathi ithuthukiswa ({time}). Lokho ekuphethe manje kuyasala futhi kusengaqoqwa.

unlock.title.en: {n, plural, one {New warrior unlocked!} other {New warriors unlocked!}}
unlock.title.text: {n, plural, one {Iqhawe elisha livuliwe!} other {Amaqhawe amasha avuliwe!}}

scout.shieldEnds.en: Your shield has {time} left: attacking ends it.

tutorial.end.daily.en: Your first daily chest is ready: Finish opens it.
tutorial.end.daily.text: Ibhokisi lakho lokuqala lansuku zonke selilungile: inkinobho ethi Qeda iyalivula.

panel.loadFailed.en: This could not open. Check your connection and try again.
panel.loadFailed.text: Lokhu akukwazanga ukuvuleka. Hlola uxhumano lwakho bese uzama futhi.

panel.staleChunk.en: A newer version of Kagemura is out. Reload to open this.
panel.staleChunk.text: Uhlobo olusha lwe-Kagemura selukhona. Layisha kabusha ukuze uvule lokhu.

quality.slowBattles.en: This phone drew battles slowly, so Kagemura will use lighter graphics from the next start. You can change it in Settings → Graphics.
quality.slowBattles.text: Le foni idwebe izimpi kancane, ngakho i-Kagemura izosebenzisa imidwebo elula kusukela ekuqaleni okulandelayo. Ungakushintsha ku-Izilungiselelo → Imidwebo.

events.calendar.server.en: Schedule sent by the game's server. Every countdown is real.
events.calendar.server.text: Uhlelo oluthunyelwe yiseva yegeyimu. Konke ukubala kwehla kuyiqiniso.

events.calendar.builtIn.en: Built-in schedule. Every countdown is real.
events.calendar.builtIn.text: Uhlelo olwakhelwe ngaphakathi. Konke ukubala kwehla kuyiqiniso.

growth.invite.rule.en: When a friend who started with your friend code reaches Keep {keep} with their village on the server, you each get a fixed reward. Nothing random and nothing to buy.
growth.invite.rule.text: Uma umngane oqale ngekhodi yakho yomngane efinyelela Inqaba izinga {keep} nesigodi sakhe kuseva, nobabili nithola umklomelo ongaguquki. Akukho okungahleliwe futhi akukho okuthengwayo.

growth.invite.reward.en: Reward for each of you: {jade} Jade

growth.invite.cap.en: {cap, plural, one {Rewards for up to # friend a month.} other {Rewards for up to # friends a month.}}
growth.invite.cap.text: {cap, plural, one {Imiklomelo ngenyanga: kuze kube umngane ongu-#.} other {Imiklomelo ngenyanga: kuze kube abangane abangu-#.}}

growth.invite.counts.en: Friends who joined with your code: waiting {waiting}, ready {ready}, rewarded {rewarded}
growth.invite.counts.text: Abangane abajoyine ngekhodi yakho: abalindile {waiting}, abalungele {ready}, abaklonyeliwe {rewarded}

growth.invite.mine.waiting.en: You joined with a friend's code. Reach Keep {keep} with your village on the server and you both get the reward.
growth.invite.mine.waiting.text: Ujoyine ngekhodi yomngane. Finyelela Inqaba izinga {keep} nesigodi sakho kuseva, nobabili nizothola umklomelo.

growth.invite.mine.ready.en: You joined with a friend's code and reached Keep {keep}: your reward is ready.
growth.invite.mine.ready.text: Ujoyine ngekhodi yomngane futhi wafinyelela Inqaba izinga {keep}: umklomelo wakho usulungile.

growth.invite.mine.rewarded.en: You joined with a friend's code and collected your reward.
growth.invite.mine.rewarded.text: Ujoyine ngekhodi yomngane futhi waqoqa umklomelo wakho.

growth.invite.needsServer.en: Rewards go to a village on the server. Move your village there in Settings → Online play.
growth.invite.needsServer.text: Imiklomelo iya esigodini esikuseva. Thuthela isigodi sakho lapho ku-Izilungiselelo → Ukudlala ku-inthanethi.

growth.invite.adultsOnly.en: Friend invite rewards are for adults only. You can still add friends and play together.
growth.invite.adultsOnly.text: Imiklomelo yokumema abangane ingeyabantu abadala kuphela. Usengakwazi ukwengeza abangane nidlale ndawonye.

growth.invite.enterHint.en: {days, plural, one {Enter their friend code within # day of starting online play.} other {Enter their friend code within # days of starting online play.}}
growth.invite.enterHint.text: {days, plural, one {Faka ikhodi yomngane wakho kungakapheli usuku olungu-# uqale ukudlala ku-inthanethi.} other {Faka ikhodi yomngane wakho kungakapheli izinsuku ezingu-# uqale ukudlala ku-inthanethi.}}

growth.share.explain.en: {days, plural, one {The server checks this replay and keeps it for # day under a code. Anyone with the link can watch it. The base is shown without its name and your opponent is never named.} other {The server checks this replay and keeps it for # days under a code. Anyone with the link can watch it. The base is shown without its name and your opponent is never named.}}
growth.share.explain.text: {days, plural, one {Iseva ihlola lokhu kuphinda futhi ikugcine usuku olungu-# ngaphansi kwekhodi. Noma ubani onesixhumanisi angakubuka. Isigodi siboniswa ngaphandle kwegama laso, futhi igama lomphikisi wakho alisoze labonakala.} other {Iseva ihlola lokhu kuphinda futhi ikugcine izinsuku ezingu-# ngaphansi kwekhodi. Noma ubani onesixhumanisi angakubuka. Isigodi siboniswa ngaphandle kwegama laso, futhi igama lomphikisi wakho alisoze labonakala.}}

growth.share.minor.en: Your name is not shown on replays shared by players under 18.
growth.share.minor.text: Igama lakho alibonakali ekuphindeni okwabelwana ngakho ngabadlali abangaphansi kweminyaka eyi-18.

growth.viewer.generated.en: Against a generated base (made by the computer).

growth.viewer.failed.en: This shared replay could not be opened.
growth.viewer.failed.text: Lokhu kuphinda okwabelwene ngakho akukwazanga ukuvulwa.

growth.viewer.older.en: This replay was recorded under other battle rules, so this version of the game cannot show it.
growth.viewer.older.text: Lokhu kuphinda kuqoshwe ngaphansi kweminye imithetho yempi, ngakho lolu hlobo lwegeyimu alukwazi ukukubonisa.

alliance.banner.note.en: Banners only change how the Alliance looks: no advantage in battle or resources.
alliance.banner.note.text: Amafulegi ashintsha kuphela ukubukeka koMfelandawonye: akukho nzuzo empini noma ezinsizeni.

stats.tzNote.en: It also sends your time zone's offset from UTC, so days are counted on your own calendar.
stats.tzNote.text: Ibuye ithumele umehluko wezoni yakho yesikhathi ne-UTC, ukuze izinsuku zibalwe ngekhalenda lakho.

preview.notLive.en: Preview: this is not in the live game yet.
preview.notLive.text: Ukubuka kuqala: lokhu akukabi kugeyimu ebukhoma.

heroPick.intro.en: Choose the hero who joins your attacks.

heroPick.none.en: No hero can join yet. Heroes join from higher Keep levels.
heroPick.none.text: Akekho umpetha ongajoyina okwamanje. Abapetha bajoyina kusukela emazingeni aphezulu Enqaba.

mastery.none.en: Attack with your warriors to earn mastery.
mastery.none.text: Hlasela ngamaqhawe akho ukuze uthole ubungcweti.

terms.body.en: The terms of service for Kagemura came into force on {date}. Please read them and accept them to play online. Your village keeps working on this device either way.
terms.body.text: Imigomo yesevisi ye-Kagemura yaqala ukusebenza ngomhla: {date}. Sicela uyifunde futhi uyamukele ukuze udlale ku-inthanethi. Isigodi sakho siyaqhubeka sisebenza kule divayisi noma kunjani.

consent.apple.label.en: Help Apple decide refund requests (off until you turn it on)
consent.apple.label.text: Siza i-Apple inqume izicelo zokubuyiselwa imali (kuvaliwe uze ukuvule)

consent.apple.detail.en: When you ask Apple for a refund, Apple may ask us about the purchase. With this on, we tell Apple that it was delivered and give ranges for how old your account is and how much you have bought and been refunded. Never your name, village or chat. We never ask Apple to refuse a refund.
consent.apple.detail.text: Uma ucela i-Apple ukuthi ikubuyisele imali, i-Apple ingasibuza ngokuthenga. Uma lokhu kuvuliwe, sitshela i-Apple ukuthi kwalethwa futhi sinikeze amabanga obudala be-akhawunti yakho nokuthi uthenge malini futhi ubuyiselwe malini. Hhayi igama lakho, isigodi noma ingxoxo. Asisoze sacela i-Apple ukuthi yenqabe ukubuyiselwa kwemali.

replays.allowBase.label.en: Allow my base in other players' shared replays
replays.allowBase.label.text: Vumela isigodi sami ekuphindeni kwabanye abadlali okwabelwana ngakho

replays.allowBase.detail.en: When someone shares a replay of a raid on your village, it shows your base layout (never your name). Turn this off and your base is never shown, and shares already made of it are removed.
replays.allowBase.detail.text: Uma umuntu ebelana ngokuphinda kokugasela isigodi sakho, kubonisa ukuhlelwa kwesigodi sakho (hhayi igama lakho). Vala lokhu futhi isigodi sakho asisoze saboniswa, futhi okwabelwane ngakho okuvele kwenziwe kuyasuswa.

significantUpdate.description.en: This update changes how Kagemura works. A parent or guardian can review it before it is used.
significantUpdate.description.text: Lesi sibuyekezo sishintsha indlela i-Kagemura esebenza ngayo. Umzali noma umbheki angasibuyekeza ngaphambi kokuba sisetshenziswe.

welcome.scrollEnded.en: The Season Scroll ended, and the rewards you had not claimed were added:
welcome.scrollEnded.text: Umqulu Wesizini uphelile, futhi imiklomelo obungakayithathi yengeziwe:

pass.bonus.detail.en: {left, plural, =0 {All {max} bonuses collected this season ({got} of {max})} one {Every task still pays: the next bonus in # point ({got} of {max} this season)} other {Every task still pays: the next bonus in # points ({got} of {max} this season)}}
pass.bonus.detail.text: {left, plural, =0 {Wonke amabhonasi angu-{max} aqoqiwe kule sizini ({got} kwangu-{max})} one {Umsebenzi ngamunye usanikeza: kusele iphuzu elingu-# ukuthola ibhonasi elandelayo ({got} kwangu-{max} kule sizini)} other {Umsebenzi ngamunye usanikeza: kusele amaphuzu angu-# ukuthola ibhonasi elandelayo ({got} kwangu-{max} kule sizini)}}
